# Hive (hivenow.in)

> Hive is a hyperlocal fashion marketplace based in Kochi, Kerala, India. It connects customers with verified local boutiques and delivers clothing — ethnic wear, western wear, sarees, and menswear — to doorsteps in 1-2 hours across Ernakulam.

## Key Facts
- Operated by Beelyn LLP, registered in Ernakulam, Kerala, India
- Service area: Kochi / Ernakulam (Kakkanad, Edappally, Panampilly Nagar, Vyttila, Aluva, MG Road)
- Delivery: Same-day, typically 1-2 hours from local partner boutiques
- Categories: Women's ethnic wear, western wear, sarees, men's fashion, co-ord sets, kurtis
- Contact: +91 73560 19103 / support@hivenow.in

## Content Types
- Blog: Fashion guides, fabric advice, and styling tips tailored to Kerala's climate, written by the Hive editorial team
- Product listings: Live inventory from partner boutiques with real-time pricing and availability
- Location landing pages: Area-specific delivery information for Kochi neighborhoods
